analysis.one_line_summary: Static Black Friday promotional image for the WavyTalk Steambrush Pro offering up to 28% off.
analysis.full_description: A clean, minimalist studio product shot featuring the blush pink WavyTalk Steambrush Pro standing upright with visible steam mist emitting from its heated bristle head. A delicate pastel pink satin ribbon winds gracefully around the device against a soft off-white gradient background. On the left side, bold typographic copy displays the 'WAVYTALK' logo along with 'UP TO 28% OFF' and 'Black Friday'.
